categories.main_business_segments: Ichigo Inc. operates five main business segments: Asset Management (including J-REITs, infrastructure funds, security tokens, and private real estate funds), Shin-Chiku (value enhancement of existing real estate), Ichigo Owners (fabless real estate owner services), Hotel (hotel ownership, operation, and DX), and Clean Energy (primarily solar power generation). Each segment is managed and disclosed separately to enhance transparency and performance visibility.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary 'Shin-Chiku' (value creation) techniques, combining real estate engineering, renovation, and operational know-how to enhance asset value. In hotels, it utilizes large-scale renovations and its proprietary AI-based revenue management system (PROPERA). In clean energy, it focuses on efficient solar and planned biomass power generation, with ongoing R&D in plant-based silica applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ichigo serves institutional and individual investors (via J-REITs, private funds, and security tokens), real estate owners, tenants (office, retail, hotel), and energy buyers (utilities and corporate clients). Its end markets include commercial real estate, residential, hospitality, and renewable energy sectors, with a growing focus on sustainable infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with assets and projects spanning from Hokkaido to Okinawa. Nearly all revenue and assets are domestic, though it has a minority stake in a German solar company (GIGA.GREEN GmbH) and some overseas content distribution via its animation subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ichigo operates primarily in the midstream and downstream of the real estate and energy value chains: it acquires, enhances, manages, and operates real estate and energy assets, but outsources construction (fabless model) and does not manufacture physical assets itself.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Ichigo prioritizes sustainable infrastructure, stable stock-based earnings, and climate-positive operations. R&D focuses on green business, environmental solutions, and plant-based silica applications. The company aims for 100% renewable energy use, climate-positive status, and leadership in ESG and digital transformation within real estate and energy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of real estate sales (flow income), rental income (stock income), asset management fees, hotel operations, and electricity sales from renewable energy. The company emphasizes increasing recurring (stock) revenue, targeting over 60% of total revenue from stable sources by 2030.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ichigo competes with major Japanese real estate developers, asset managers, and renewable energy operators. It differentiates itself through its Shin-Chiku value-add model, integrated asset management, and sustainability focus. The company holds a strong position in mid-sized office, residential, and hotel assets, and is a recognized leader in sustainable infrastructure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥83.6 billion, with operating profit of ¥16.3 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥15.2 billion. Assets total ¥406.7 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue and profit over the past five years, with a significant increase in recurring income and a robust balance sheet.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ichigo’s unique value proposition lies in its ability to create new value in existing real estate (Shin-Chiku), deliver high capital efficiency through a fabless model, and provide stable, sustainable returns. Its integrated approach to asset management, digital innovation (AI revenue management), and strong ESG credentials (climate-positive, RE100, CDP A-list) set it apart as a leader in sustainable infrastructure.
